An Interactive World History Timeline

THE CHRONICLES

|  BY CHAUDHRY MUHAMMAD RAYYAN SHAHID  |

On the night of 5 April 2026, I had a thought while having a chat with a close friend of mine at his new place in Norwich, England.

I said to him:

“I wish there was a website that could showcase all the major events of history, where a curious person could understand it all by looking at that one platform. I’m amazed that we don’t have anything like that in this day and age.”

From there, “The Chronicles” emerged,

Sit back and imagine moving through thousands of years of time, watching the events of every part of the world unfold around you in their own beauty. Scroll downwards as the centuries pass by. Scroll horizontally and you cross the world within a single timeframe. Watching what was happening in Arabia in parallel to what was happening at that time in the region of China, in West Africa, in Mesoamerica, in the Nordic north, in the subcontinent or in the European region.

8 world regions and 1 thematic band, containing 25 columns, 5,785 years of approximate history from Adam to the present, held together by a dual calendar that carries BCE/CE and AH side by side, so that no civilization is made to keep time by another’s reckoning.

As you open every single cell. Behind each one sits a dense, fully sourced entry, prophets and revelation, caliphates and battles, Islamic, Christian and Jewish scholarship, international relations, science, philosophy and discovery. Each claim traced to its scripture, its hadith with grading, or the academic record, and read through the insight of comparative religion, international relations, philosophy and discovery, so that history here is not merely listed but understood.

Where a single cell could not carry the weight of what happened, the Chronicles opens outward into full companion works of their own as a hyperlink: check the highlighted cell of “Before Adam”, on everything that unfolded before humanity was ever placed upon the earth or “Comparative Religion”.

Throughout, Ask Rayyan stands as a guide, searching the entire corpus at once, timeline and companion documents together. So that a question asked in plain words returns the exact place where its answer lives.

It was built over countless hours: through reading the relevant books, the authentic historical records and the religious scriptures, through standing in the historical places themselves to gather the true essence of them, and through researching as far and as carefully as I possibly could, with weekly updates to integrate more events from the past and the present placing them exactly where they belong in the history with the most authentic unbiased information. “The Chronicles” is a never-ending historical platform to put history into perspective & to put the dynamics of the contemporary world into understanding.

Start your journey.
